Package frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation

Class MechanismSimBase

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.libraries.Repulsor.Simulation.MechanismSimBase
Direct Known Subclasses:
SimpleMechanismSim
public abstract class MechanismSimBase extends Object
Abstract base for mechanism simulations with friction, loads, and sensor support.
